perks.name: Clown Cartridge
perks.desc: Reloading this weapon randomly overfills it from reserves.

perks.name: Auto-Loading Holster
perks.desc: The holstered weapon is automatically reloaded after a short period of time.

perks.name: Supercharged Magazine
perks.desc:
While amplified, ammo is gradually transferred from reserves to the magazine. 

While in Speed Booster, ammo regenerates faster and overflows the magazine.

perks.name: Jolting Feedback
perks.desc:
Dealing repeated damage with this weapon inflicts Jolt. 

While amplified, Jolt is applied faster.

perks.name: Rapid Hit
perks.desc: Rapid precision hits temporarily increase stability and reload speed.

perks.name: Light Touch
perks.desc: This weapon gains reload speed, handling, and aim down sight speed when you are amplified, radiant, or have Devour.

perks.name: Rangefinder
perks.desc: Aiming this weapon increases its effective range and zoom magnification. Increased projectile velocity while aiming Rocket Launchers, Grenade Launchers, and Bows.

perks.name: Turnabout
perks.desc: Using this weapon to break the shield of a combatant or a Guardian using their Super will grant you an overshield.

perks.name: Well-Rounded
perks.desc:
Throwing a grenade or hitting a target with a charged melee grants a stacking bonus to weapon stability, handling, and range.

Using a Super grants maximum stacks.

perks.name: Firing Line
perks.desc: This weapon deals increased precision damage when near two or more allies.

perks.name: Vorpal Weapon
perks.desc: Increased damage against bosses, vehicles, and Guardians with their Super active.

perks.name: Gear Shift
perks.desc: Reloading after a final blow or becoming amplified grants a period of increased damage. Stacks 5x.

perks.name: Elemental Honing
perks.desc: Dealing unique elemental damage grants this weapon a stacking damage bonus. This bonus is increased for kinetic weapons.

perks.name: Precision Instrument
perks.desc: Dealing sustained damage increases precision damage.

perks.name: Aggregate Charge
perks.desc: This weapon deals more damage for each elemental debuff applied to the target.

perks.name: Adaptive Munitions
perks.desc: This weapon adapts its damage output and effectiveness against energy shields that don't match the weapon's damage type.

perks.name: Demolitionist
perks.desc: Kills with this weapon generate grenade energy. Activating your grenade ability reloads this weapon from reserves.

perks.name: Frenzy
perks.desc: Being in combat for an extended time increases damage, handling, and reload for this weapon until you are out of combat.

perks.name: Rampage
perks.desc: Kills with this weapon temporarily grant increased damage. Stacks 3x.

perks.name: Bitterspite
perks.desc:
While this weapon is equipped, taking damage accelerates its next reload.

Taking more damage increases the effect.

notes: Constructed by @Adamsdown_Boy (PvE PvE-Boss PvE-SustainedDamage PvE-EndGame M+KB Controller): Backup PvE roll for sustained DPS against a single yellow-bar target in activities rated Normal, Hard or Very Hard difficulty. Stormchaser is an adaptive burst linear fusion rifle, which are rated D-Tier for endgame PvE by @TheAegisRelic tiering spreadsheet https://linktr.ee/TheAegisRelic being "worse DPS than even upper-middle special weapons and no access to ammo return perks". The frame intrinsic offers built in Anti-Barrier, fires a 3-round burst as per the https://www.destiny2.science/ Destiny Data Compendium. The stats are decent by comparison with its peers - you can see them at https://destiny.report/w/2862666249/stormchaser and hopefully https://d2foundry.gg/w/2862666249 will show how weapon stats impact in-game performance when the site is back up and running. The recoil direction is right and reasonably tight so you could improve recoil control or just look to boost Stability to help hit crits, or Handling if you can land your shots. As the battery perk, Accelerated Coils improves charge time by 40ms at the cost of ×0.98 base damage, or Enhanced Battery with a Backup Mag mod gets you the maximum of 7 shots. To be honest, adaptive burst LFRs are a weak subfamily for boss damage but, if you insist, in the first trait perk column, Clown Cartridge overflows the battery by between ×1.1-1.5 rounded up (×1.13-1.5 when enhanced) randomly on a manual reload, Auto-Loading Holster refills the battery 3.5s (3.3s enhanced) after stowing so you always arrive at a damage phase with a full battery, and Rapid Hit stacks up to ×5 on crit hits for +25 Stability and +60 Reload Speed with a ×0.92 animation multiplier for a refreshable 2s. For damage, in the second column there's Precision Instrument grants escalating damage repeated crit hits up to a max ×1.25 at 6 stacks (×1.3 enhanced) for 1.25s or until you miss a crit or Firing Line boosts crit damage by ×1.2 when you're within 15m of two or more allies in a fireteam. The Bitterspite origin trait stacks up to ×5 on receiving damage which are consumed on reload to boost Reload Speed up to a max +50 (+55 enhanced) with a ×0.9 reload animation scalar. Recommended MW: Charge Time, with a Backup Mag or Charge Time mod, or your preferred choice to boost weapon stats, ammo generation, or elemental pickups for builds.

Adamsdown_Boy - information as at v8.0.0.6 PvE / PvE-Boss / PvE-BossSpec / PvE-EndGame / PvE-God / M+KB / Controller): PvE pick for killing boss-tier Subjugators. As per @mossy_max (https://x.com/mossy_max/status/1804893174965338387) - boss-tier Subjugators have a 20% damage reduction to all non-matching damage, going up to 30% DR to all damage after they "screech", which counts as a shield in-game and reacts to shield-based trait perks. Stormchaser is the adaptive burst LFR that's still obtainable from the Duality dungeon. First, Arrowhead Brake to help with recoil, or Chambered Compensator or Polygonal Rifling will also to help land consistent crits. Ionized Battery with Backup Mag max out the battery at 7 shots, or Backup Mag alone provides 6, in which case op for Accelerated Coils for better burst damage or Particle Repeater for more stability. In the first trait column, Clown Cartridge can get you to 11 shots, or Rapid Hit can make landing crits easier and boost reload speed. In the second, Adaptive Munitions provides a +30% damage boost after 3 hits. The Bitterspite origin trait is useful, boosting reload if you're taking damage. Recommended MW: Charge Time, with a Backup Mag mod
Speedrunner's Shopping List: Ranged sustained damage (good for: all S21 raids and dungeons)

[YeezyGT's S18] [MW: Charge] "Stormchaser still reigns as one of the best-in-slot options, currently being the only burst-fire frame, and making up DPS potential with fast reload options such as Rapid Hit/Frenzy. There's a roll for everyone - Auto-Loading Holster, Clown Cartridge, Firing Line, Frenzy/Vorpal for solo activities - all sorts. It's well-loved, and well-loved for a reason." tags:god-pve
Chevy's S17 Super Pog PVE List Charge MW tags:pve, M+KB

pandapaxxy (PvE / M+KB / Controller): "A three round burst linear fusion. It’s most similar to high-impact fusions, but it does significantly more damage and charges faster. For PvE auto-loading holster, clown cartridge, or rapid hit are all fantastic options. Firing line, frenzy, and vorpal are all really close in terms of best in slot, but I would rank them in that order. Firing line is the easiest to proc, frenzy can be your whole loadout, and vorpal while the weakest is still 10% damage. Depending on how you decide to play will determine which is best for you." Recommended MW - Reload.

pandapaxxy (PvP / M+KB / Controller): "I think Stormchaser is a weird weapon for the crucible. It does do enough to body shot with the whole burst, but you’re better off going for a crit with just a regular linear fusion rifle or body shot with adagio. Stormchaser is cool and I think it will see some use, but I don’t think it will be anyone’s first pick." Recommended MW - Charge Time.

Inspired by DMB Player Versus Enemies Podcast 19. PvE first choice roll for boss damage in a fireteam. Bitterspite origin trait is excellent - faster reload is always useful. This is our first aggressive frame linear fusion rifle, is a fantastic legendary boss damage weapon. You can use Fluted Barrel to boost Handling and Stability or Arrowhead Brake to straight up the Recoil Direction. Enhanced Battery gives you seven shots, boosted by up to 50% with Clown Cartridge, and then Firing Line boosts damage when you're close to the other fire members. Recommended MW: Reload Speed or Stability, with a Backup Mag mod to boost the magazine size to 8 - a possible 12 with Clown Cartridge.
